summary: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq notification granting a 180-day second compliance period until October 26, 2026, to cure a Minimum Bid Price deficiency, as its shares had closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. The company meets all other listing requirements and may pursue a reverse stock split if needed. No price, premium, or advisors are stated. The extension provides time to restore compliance, but failure risks delisting and a potential appeal. Watch for reverse stock split announcements or trading patterns approaching the $1.00 threshold for 10 consecutive days.
